title: Hushroom
welcome: Hi, thanks for helping us test this website. I'll guide you through a few short tasks, one at a time. There are no wrong answers. We're testing the site, not you.

tasks.title: Find a room
tasks.say: You've got a group project meeting with three coursemates tomorrow afternoon. You need somewhere quiet for the four of you from 2pm to 4pm. Use the app to find a room.

tasks.title: Book it
tasks.say: Pick a room that suits your group and book it.

tasks.title: Check the booking
tasks.say: One of your group has messaged asking where you're meeting. Find the booking you just made.

thanks: Your answers help us fix the confusing bits.
